verses.original: מַשָּׂ֤א דְבַר־ יְהוָה֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חַדְרָ֔ךְ וְדַמֶּ֖שֶׂק מְנֻחָת֑וֹ כִּ֤י עֵ֣ין אָדָ֔ם וְכֹ֖ל שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ לַֽיהוָה֙
verses.transliteration: maś·śā ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh bə·’e·reṣ ḥaḏ·rāḵ wə·ḏam·me·śeq mə·nu·ḥā·ṯōw kî ‘ên ’ā·ḏām wə·ḵōl šiḇ·ṭê yiś·rā·’êl Yah·weh
verses.literal: [This is] the burden of the word of the LORD against the land of Hadrach and Damascus its resting place for the eyes of men and of all the tribes of Israel are upon the LORD

verses.original: וְגַם־ חֲמָ֖ת תִּגְבָּל־ בָּ֑הּ צֹ֣ר וְצִיד֔וֹן כִּ֥י מְאֹֽד׃ חָֽכְמָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam- ḥă·māṯ tiḡ·bāl- bāh ṣōr wə·ṣî·ḏō·wn kî mə·’ōḏ ḥāḵ·māh
verses.literal: and also [against] Hamath which borders it as well as Tyre and Sidon though they are very shrewd

verses.original: צֹ֛ר וַתִּ֥בֶן לָ֑הּ מָצ֖וֹר וַתִּצְבָּר־ כֶּ֙סֶף֙ כֶּֽעָפָ֔ר וְחָר֖וּץ כְּטִ֥יט חוּצֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ṣōr wat·ti·ḇen lāh mā·ṣō·wr wat·tiṣ·bār- ke·sep̄ ke·‘ā·p̄ār wə·ḥā·rūṣ kə·ṭîṭ ḥū·ṣō·wṯ
verses.literal: Tyre has built herself a fortress she has heaped up silver like dust and gold like the dirt of the streets

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה אֲדֹנָי֙ יֽוֹרִשֶׁ֔נָּה וְהִכָּ֥ה חֵילָ֑הּ בַיָּ֖ם וְהִ֖יא תֵּאָכֵֽל׃ בָּאֵ֥שׁ
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ’ă·ḏō·nāy yō·w·ri·šen·nāh wə·hik·kāh ḥê·lāh ḇay·yām wə·hî tê·’ā·ḵêl bā·’êš
verses.literal: Behold the Lord will impoverish her and cast her wealth into the sea and she will be consumed by fire

verses.original: אַשְׁקְל֜וֹן תֵּרֶ֨א וְתִירָ֗א וְעַזָּה֙ מְאֹ֔ד וְתָחִ֣יל וְעֶקְר֖וֹן כִּֽי־ מֶבָּטָ֑הּ הֹבִ֣ישׁ וְאָ֤בַד מֶ֙לֶךְ֙ מֵֽעַזָּ֔ה וְאַשְׁקְל֖וֹן לֹ֥א תֵשֵֽׁב׃
verses.transliteration: ’aš·qə·lō·wn tê·re wə·ṯî·rā wə·‘az·zāh mə·’ōḏ wə·ṯā·ḥîl wə·‘eq·rō·wn kî- meb·bā·ṭāh hō·ḇîš wə·’ā·ḇaḏ me·leḵ mê·‘az·zāh wə·’aš·qə·lō·wn lō ṯê·šêḇ
verses.literal: Ashkelon will see and fear Gaza will writhe in agony . . . as will Ekron for her hope will wither There will cease to be a king in Gaza and Ashkelon will be uninhabited . . .

verses.original: מַמְזֵ֖ר וְיָשַׁ֥ב בְּאַשְׁדּ֑וֹד וְהִכְרַתִּ֖י גְּא֥וֹן פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: mam·zêr wə·yā·šaḇ bə·’aš·dō·wḏ wə·hiḵ·rat·tî gə·’ō·wn pə·liš·tîm
verses.literal: A mixed race will occupy Ashdod and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines

verses.original: וַהֲסִרֹתִ֨י דָמָ֜יו מִפִּ֗יו וְשִׁקֻּצָיו֙ מִבֵּ֣ין שִׁנָּ֔יו ה֖וּא גַּם־ וְנִשְׁאַ֥ר לֵֽאלֹהֵ֑ינוּ וְהָיָה֙ כְּאַלֻּ֣ף בִּֽיהוּדָ֔ה וְעֶקְר֖וֹן כִּיבוּסִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wa·hă·si·rō·ṯî ḏā·māw mip·pîw wə·šiq·qu·ṣāw mib·bên šin·nāw hū gam- wə·niš·’ar lê·lō·hê·nū wə·hā·yāh kə·’al·lup̄ bî·hū·ḏāh wə·‘eq·rō·wn kî·ḇū·sî
verses.literal: I will remove the blood from their mouths and the abominations from between their teeth Then they too will become a remnant for our God they will become like a clan in Judah and Ekron will be like the Jebusites

verses.original: וְחָנִ֨יתִי לְבֵיתִ֤י מִצָּבָה֙ מֵעֹבֵ֣ר וּמִשָּׁ֔ב וְלֹֽא־ ע֖וֹד נֹגֵ֑שׂ יַעֲבֹ֧ר עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם כִּ֥י עַתָּ֖ה רָאִ֥יתִי בְעֵינָֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥā·nî·ṯî lə·ḇê·ṯî miṣ·ṣā·ḇāh mê·‘ō·ḇêr ū·miš·šāḇ wə·lō- ‘ō·wḏ nō·ḡêś ya·‘ă·ḇōr ‘ă·lê·hem kî ‘at·tāh rā·’î·ṯî ḇə·‘ê·nāy
verses.literal: But I will camp around My house because of an army because of those who march to and fro . . . and never again . . . will an oppressor overrun [My people] for now I keep watch with My own eyes

verses.original: גִּילִ֨י מְאֹ֜ד בַּת־ צִיּ֗וֹן הָרִ֙יעִי֙ בַּ֣ת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם הִנֵּ֤ה מַלְכֵּךְ֙ יָ֣בוֹא לָ֔ךְ ה֑וּא צַדִּ֥יק וְנוֹשָׁ֖ע עָנִי֙ וְרֹכֵ֣ב עַל־ חֲמ֔וֹר וְעַל־ עַ֖יִר בֶּן־ אֲתֹנֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: gî·lî mə·’ōḏ baṯ- ṣî·yō·wn hā·rî·‘î baṯ yə·rū·šā·lim hin·nêh mal·kêḵ yā·ḇō·w lāḵ hū ṣad·dîq wə·nō·wō·šā‘ ‘ā·nî wə·rō·ḵêḇ ‘al- ḥă·mō·wr wə·‘al- ‘a·yir ben- ’ă·ṯō·nō·wṯ
verses.literal: Rejoice greatly O Daughter of Zion Shout in triumph O Daughter of Jerusalem See your King comes to you righteous and victorious humble and riding on a donkey on a colt the foal of a donkey

verses.original: וְהִכְרַתִּי־ רֶ֣כֶב מֵאֶפְרַ֗יִם וְסוּס֙ מִיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם קֶ֣שֶׁת מִלְחָמָ֔ה וְנִכְרְתָה֙ וְדִבֶּ֥ר שָׁל֖וֹם לַגּוֹיִ֑ם וּמָשְׁלוֹ֙ מִיָּ֣ם עַד־ יָ֔ם וּמִנָּהָ֖ר עַד־ אַפְסֵי־ אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiḵ·rat·tî- re·ḵeḇ mê·’ep̄·ra·yim wə·sūs mî·rū·šā·lim qe·šeṯ mil·ḥā·māh wə·niḵ·rə·ṯāh wə·ḏib·ber šā·lō·wm lag·gō·w·yim ū·mā·šə·lōw mî·yām ‘aḏ- yām ū·min·nā·hār ‘aḏ- ’ap̄·sê- ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: And I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim and the horse from Jerusalem and the bow of war will be broken Then He will proclaim peace to the nations His dominion will extend from sea to sea and from the Euphrates to the ends of the earth

verses.original: גַּם־ אַ֣תְּ בְּדַם־ בְּרִיתֵ֗ךְ שִׁלַּ֤חְתִּי אֲסִירַ֙יִךְ֙ אֵ֥ין מַ֖יִם בּֽוֹ׃ מִבּ֔וֹר
verses.transliteration: gam- ’at bə·ḏam- bə·rî·ṯêḵ šil·laḥ·tî ʾă·sī·ra·yiḵ ’ên ma·yim bōw mib·bō·wr
verses.literal: - As for you because of the blood of [My] covenant I will release your prisoners from the waterless . . . pit

verses.original: שׁ֚וּבוּ לְבִצָּר֔וֹן אֲסִירֵ֖י הַתִּקְוָ֑ה גַּם־ הַיּ֕וֹם מַגִּ֥יד אָשִׁ֥יב לָֽךְ׃ מִשְׁנֶ֖ה
verses.transliteration: šû·b̲û lə·ḇiṣ·ṣā·rō·wn ’ă·sî·rê hat·tiq·wāh gam- hay·yō·wm mag·gîḏ ’ā·šîḇ lāḵ miš·neh
verses.literal: Return to your stronghold O prisoners of hope even today I declare that I will restore to you double

verses.original: כִּֽי־ דָרַ֨כְתִּי לִ֜י יְהוּדָ֗ה קֶ֚שֶׁת מִלֵּ֣אתִי אֶפְרַ֔יִם וְעוֹרַרְתִּ֤י בָנַ֙יִךְ֙ צִיּ֔וֹן עַל־ בָּנַ֖יִךְ יָוָ֑ן וְשַׂמְתִּ֖יךְ כְּחֶ֥רֶב גִּבּֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḏā·raḵ·tî lî yə·hū·ḏāh qe·šeṯ mil·lê·ṯî ’ep̄·ra·yim wə·‘ō·w·rar·tî ḇā·na·yiḵ ṣî·yō·wn ‘al- bā·na·yiḵ yā·wān wə·śam·tîḵ kə·ḥe·reḇ gib·bō·wr
verses.literal: For I will bend Judah as My bow and fit it with Ephraim I will rouse your sons O Zion against the sons of Greece I will make you like the sword of a mighty man

verses.original: וַֽיהוָה֙ יֵֽרָאֶ֔ה עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם חִצּ֑וֹ וְיָצָ֥א כַבָּרָ֖ק וַֽאדֹנָ֤י יְהֹוִה֙ יִתְקָ֔ע בַּשּׁוֹפָ֣ר וְהָלַ֖ךְ בְּסַעֲר֥וֹת תֵּימָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh yê·rā·’eh ‘ă·lê·hem ḥiṣ·ṣōw wə·yā·ṣā ḵab·bā·rāq wa·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh yiṯ·qā‘ baš·šō·w·p̄ār wə·hā·laḵ bə·sa·‘ă·rō·wṯ tê·mān
verses.literal: Then the LORD will appear over them and His arrow will go forth like lightning The Lord GOD will sound the ram’s horn and advance in the whirlwinds of the south

verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה צְבָאוֹת֮ יָגֵ֣ן עֲלֵיהֶם֒ וְאָכְל֗וּ וְכָֽבְשׁוּ֙ אַבְנֵי־ קֶ֔לַע וְשָׁת֥וּ הָמ֖וּ כְּמוֹ־ יָ֑יִן וּמָֽלְאוּ֙ כַּמִּזְרָ֔ק כְּזָוִיּ֖וֹת מִזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ yā·ḡên ‘ă·lê·hem wə·’ā·ḵə·lū wə·ḵā·ḇə·šū ’aḇ·nê- qe·la‘ wə·šā·ṯū hā·mū kə·mōw- yā·yin ū·mā·lə·’ū kam·miz·rāq kə·zā·wî·yō·wṯ miz·bê·aḥ
verses.literal: The LORD of Hosts will shield them They will destroy and conquer with slingstones . . . they will drink [and] roar as with wine And they will be filled like sprinkling bowls [drenched] like the corners of the altar

verses.original: הַה֖וּא בַּיּ֥וֹם יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֛ם וְֽהוֹשִׁיעָ֞ם כְּצֹ֣אן עַמּ֑וֹ כִּ֚י אַבְנֵי־ נֵ֔זֶר מִֽתְנוֹסְס֖וֹת עַל־ אַדְמָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ha·hū bay·yō·wm Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem wə·hō·wō·šî·‘ām kə·ṣōn ‘am·mōw kî ’aḇ·nê- nê·zer miṯ·nō·ws·sō·wṯ ‘al- ’aḏ·mā·ṯōw
verses.literal: On that day the LORD their God will save them as the flock of His people for like jewels in a crown they will sparkle over His land

verses.original: כִּ֥י מַה־ טּוּב֖וֹ וּמַה־ יָפְי֑וֹ דָּגָן֙ בַּֽחוּרִ֔ים יְנוֹבֵ֥ב וְתִיר֖וֹשׁ בְּתֻלֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: kî mah- ṭū·ḇōw ū·mah- yā·p̄ə·yōw dā·ḡān ba·ḥū·rîm yə·nō·w·ḇêḇ wə·ṯî·rō·wōš bə·ṯu·lō·wṯ
verses.literal: - How lovely they will be and how beautiful Grain will make the young men flourish and new wine the young women
